Question Choices: Round 28 to the nearest 10. What number do you get?
Hints: Is the ones digit 5 or more?
Solution: 28 is between 20 and 30. It is 8 from 20 and 2 from 30, so round to 30.

Question Choices: Round 42 to the nearest 10. What number do you get?
Hints: Is the ones digit 5 or more?
Solution: 42 is between 40 and 50. It is 2 from 40 and 8 from 50, so round to 40.

Question Choices: Round 235 to the nearest 100. What number do you get?
Solution: 235 is between 200 and 300, below the midpoint 250. It rounds to 200.

Question Choices: Fill: Round 550 to the nearest 100 is __. Round 555 to the nearest 10 is __
Hints: For hundreds, compare with the halfway point between neighboring hundreds. For tens, compare with the halfway point between neighboring tens. Round halfway up.
Solution: 550 is halfway between 500 and 600; the usual whole-number rule rounds halfway up to 600. 555 is halfway between 550 and 560, so it rounds to 560. Fill 600, 560.

Question Choices: Select. Place 398 on a number line between 390 and 400. Which is it closer to? ~~390 | 400~~
Hints: Think of is it the same as round to the nearest 100 or 10?
Solution: 398 is 8 from 390 and 2 from 400. It is closer to 400.

Question Choices: Round 1579 to the nearest 100. What number do you get?

Question Choices: Round 999 to the nearest 100. What number do you get?

Question Choices: Fill: Round 377 to the nearest 10 is __ and to the nearest 100 is __
Hints: Two answers. Is the ones digit 5 or more? Is the tens digit 5 or more?
Solution: 377 is 3 from 380, so to tens it rounds to 380. It is 77 from 300 and 23 from 400, so to hundreds it rounds to 400. Fill 380, 400.
